title: My Country 'Tis of Thee: My Faith, My Family, Our Future
author: Dr. Ben Carson with Candy Carson
target_audience: Readers interested in American politics and social commentary
Supporters of Dr. Ben Carson and followers of his public career
Individuals seeking personal and political inspiration
Audiences interested in faith-based perspectives on American society
General readers of memoir and autobiography
core_themes: Faith and its influence on public life
primary_purpose: To share Dr. Ben Carson’s vision for America’s future, blending personal memoir and reflections on faith, family, and national principles with a call for renewed patriotism, social responsibility, and political reform.

structure_format.narrative_style: Personal, reflective, conversational with persuasive undertones
structure_format.organization: Main chapters detailing Carson's upbringing, career in medicine, faith, and political awakening; each chapter links personal stories to broader social and political commentary
features: Discussion of policy and social issues

key_concepts_lessons: The value of hard work and perseverance in overcoming poverty and social barriers
The importance of faith in guiding personal and public life
The significance of education as a path to opportunity
Personal responsibility as the foundation for societal success
Patriotism and commitment to the principles founding the United States
The need for civil discourse and unity in addressing societal challenges
Caution against growing governmental overreach and loss of individual freedoms
notable_features: Blends autobiography with social and political manifesto
Focus on the intersection of faith, family, and public life
Advocates for traditional American values and reforms
Provides insight into Carson's personal background and philosophy
cultural_historical_context: Published in 2014 amid national debates on healthcare, education, and political polarization, the book reflects a renewed interest in outsider voices in American politics. Carson, a renowned neurosurgeon, had risen to national attention for his politically charged speech at the 2013 National Prayer Breakfast, leading to his emergence as a public figure and eventual presidential candidate.
reception_impact: Bestseller, particularly within conservative and faith-based circles
Helped establish Ben Carson’s credibility as a political thinker ahead of his 2016 presidential bid
Praised by supporters for its inspirational and values-driven message
Criticized by some for oversimplification of complex social issues or for political partisanship
